answers.rationale: The requirement specifies details for metal-clad switchgear construction, including panel material, compartment separation, and other features. These align with the description of CROWN-ARMV, which is arc-resistant metal-clad MV switchgear built to IEEE C37.20.2 standards.
The power supply and wiring specifications are typical for switchgear applications. CROWN-ARMV, as a metal-clad MV switchgear product, is designed to accommodate such electrical requirements.

The environmental and site conditions, including temperature range, altitude, and seismic/wind loading, are relevant to the installation and operation of metal-clad switchgear. CROWN-ARMV is suitable for such conditions as it is designed for robust and reliable operation in various environments.
